All 7 tests pass. Here's what was fixed:

1. **`overlaps`** — changed `<=` to `<` so touching intervals (end of one == start of another) are not considered overlapping, per docstring.

2. **`merge_intervals`** — sorted in-place mutated the input list (violated "argument must not be modified") and used `<` instead of `<=` for merge condition (so touching intervals weren't merged). Fixed by sorting a copy and using `<=`.

3. **`find_free_slots`** — multiple issues: didn't clamping busy intervals to day window, didn't handle gaps >= min_len (used `>` instead of `>=`), missed the final gap after the last busy interval past `day_end`, and didn't account for cursor going past `day_end`. Fixed by using `merge_intervals` to first merge overlapping busy intervals, clamping to the day window, checking `>= min_len`, and adding the trailing gap.
